narrative.overview:
Transit-cartography precision becomes a quiet, working web application. System-selected near-white or charcoal grounds, contrasting neutral text and restrained borders let the Toronto map, camera image and community information hold attention. Orange identifies the brand, meaningful actions and issue states. The two-line wordmark and simple line icons remain clear at phone size.

The dashboard, automatic scanner, public add-bin form, bin details, shared manual report form and public case review share one neutral light/dark system, including dialogs, fields, metadata and browser safe areas. The idle scanner centers one enablement action in a dominant neutral viewing area. Operational feedback appears when relevant; the manual fallback remains compact. Photos and live video are task evidence rather than decorative imagery.

This is an Operate reconciliation of the approved, restrained transit/cartographic direction, retaining seed e4140d1ddb7deb16. No new direction roll, approved comp or QUALITY BAR card belongs to this update. The source authority is the final theme, shell, dashboard, scanner, add-bin, map, bin-detail, shared manual-report and public case-review implementation. This record covers those main surfaces; it does not establish an audit of every legacy page or physical camera, AI recognition or GPS success.
keyCharacteristics: System-selected neutral light and dark grounds across the main surfaces.
Geometric headings with compact, readable interface text and steady tabular counts.
Thin divisions and modest radii; ambient shadows belong to floating content.
Horizontal navigation, native controls and a dominant camera view with a centered cover crop.
Real map data and private photo evidence, with explicit states and provenance.

rules.name: The Action and Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use orange for identity, meaningful actions and observed issue states; keep inventory markers quieter and explain map colors in text.

rules.name: The Shared Theme Rule
rules.body: Use the semantic theme variables for page grounds, surfaces, text, metadata, fields and dialogs. Their light and dark values change together under the system preference; video and data-layer literals remain scoped to their materials.

rules.name: The Numbers Stay Steady Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for overview metrics and changing report counts so refreshes do not disturb alignment.

rules.name: The Floating Content Rule
rules.body: Reserve ambient shadows for content that overlays another surface; use borders for the map, report panel and toolbar.

dos: **Do** apply the shared system theme to the dashboard, scanner, add-bin form, bin details, manual reporting, public case review, metadata, native fields, dialogs and safe areas.
**Do** use Space Grotesk for headings and the wordmark, and DM Sans for controls, counts and report details.
**Do** retain horizontal navigation and compact native filters at phone sizes.
**Do** keep map legends and compact provider/City attribution readable in both themes.
**Do** keep visible focus outlines and honor reduced-motion preferences for CSS and map movement.
**Do** preserve the centered live-video cover crop across display, capture, motion sampling and overlays, while keeping full-image photo previews contained.
**Do** keep camera dimensions stable as feedback appears below the frame, with the compact manual fallback.
**Do** keep community provenance and private photo evidence distinct from City inventory.
**Do** identify the GPS suggestion separately from the selected bin, and label community resolution while keeping its history visible.
donts: **Don't** restore orange scanner trim, brown page planes, a provider/billing card, persistent location controls, idle/control strips or a persistent 311 footer sentence.
**Don't** add a scanner power control or Dashboard link; the brand is its home navigation and leaving the scanner releases active hardware.
**Don't** restore the provider-unavailable idle sentence or make feedback resize the camera.
**Don't** gate public case review on setup or display private management evidence in the public queue.
**Don't** restore a dashboard data-disclosure footer or Live demo/Connection setup items in More.
**Don't** fill information surfaces with orange, add shadows to every panel or introduce promotional scaffolding.
**Don't** turn compact information labels into decorative all-caps kickers or introduce a system-font display hierarchy.
**Don't** show demo/QA activity as public reports or imply that untested camera, AI or GPS flows succeeded.
